 Follow One Piece Chapter 1198 Spoilers & Manga Plot Leaks
 Ishita Verma Wed, November 4, 2026 at 6:34 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Toei Animation The spoilers for One Piece Chapter 1198 are now available online. In the previous chapter, the major focus was on Saint Killingham's battle with Sanji, who attacks the Holy Knight with a spinning back kick. Here are all the spoilers fans need to know regarding the plot leaks of Chapter 1198 of the One Piece manga.
 List of One Piece Chapter 1198 spoilers
 Here are the spoilers for One Piece Chapter 1198.
 Killingham tries to run away from Sanji
 According to the plot leaks, the chapter is titled "The Island of Monsters." It begins with Killingham running from Sanji after the Straw Hat's kick shatters his armor. The scene mirrors how Saint Sommers fled from Zoro. Meanwhile, it shows how the Rain God Zaza MMA stretches her body to reach the ship and sacrifices her arm so the kidnapped children can land safely. Suddenly, while running for his life, Killingham senses the World Government leader Imu's haki.
 Luffy has reportedly left the battlefield
 The next scene shows Imu transforming into his third form, giving him an elongated torso, massive horns, and a long neck. Loki also appears in his hybrid Zoan form, and his battle with Imu begins. Loki also comments on Luffy, who has apparently left the battlefield, a move that shocks the Prince of Elbaph.
 Luffy gets a new form
 Imu decides to confront Loki about the ancient technology Elbaph possesses, but the Prince refuses to say anything. Although Imu praises Loki's strength, the World Government leader defeats him with a single attack. Imu then decides to go after Luffy, but reveals that he needs to return to Mary Geoise or his life will be in danger. Meanwhile, Gaban and Usopp also wonder where Luffy went. Gaban then declares that Luffy is a Zoan-type. Fans then witness Luffy in a new mysterious form sitting on the roof of a house in the village. Based on the spoilers, he now has black hair, a tail, fangs, and an ape-like nose. He is seen looking at the rain God and immediately jumps on her and bites her, causing her to explode.
